summary.zh: 让智能体操作本机 Blender:看场景、改模型和材质,和 3D 工作台互传。
summary.en: Let your agent work in Blender on this computer: inspect scenes, edit models and materials, and trade scenes with the 3D studio.

description.zh: 使用你选择的智能体操作本机 Blender：查询场景、编辑模型和材质。3D 工作台可发送场景与镜头，接收加工结果并保留 .blend 工程。需安装配套 Blender MCP 2.2.9 Add-on。
description.en: Use your chosen agent to inspect and edit local Blender models and materials. Send scenes and cameras from the 3D studio, receive edited models, and keep .blend projects. Requires the matching Blender MCP 2.2.9 add-on.

description.zh: 读取当前 Blender 场景:有哪些物体、在哪、多大,网格和骨架是否健康;可按名字筛、看某个物体的子树。只读,不改动任何东西。
description.en: Read the current Blender scene: which objects, where, how big, and whether meshes and rigs are healthy; filter by name or list one object's children. Read-only.

description.zh: 把场景渲成一张图:视口所见、透过场景相机、或从几个角度看某个物体。只读,不改动任何东西。
description.en: Render the scene as one image: what the viewport shows, through the scene camera, or a target from several angles. Read-only.

description.zh: 连上的 Blender 版本、Add-on 和服务是否配套、开了哪些素材库和 3D 生成服务。只读。
description.en: The connected Blender's version, whether the add-on matches the server, and which asset libraries and 3D generators are on. Read-only.

description.zh: 在 Poly Haven / Sketchfab / Poly Pizza 里搜现成的模型、贴图、HDRI。只查不下载,不改动场景。
description.en: Search Poly Haven / Sketchfab / Poly Pizza for existing models, textures and HDRIs. Searches only; nothing is downloaded or changed.

description.zh: 交给 Add-on 里开着的 3D 生成服务(可能按次收费)生成一个模型放进场景。
description.en: Have a 3D generator switched on in the add-on (may charge per run) make a model and place it in the scene.

description.zh: 原始的 Blender 代码执行入口。只供 3D 场景互通的固定脚本使用；智能体建模走内置的 blender_execute（有确认卡与独立放行档）。
description.en: Raw Blender code execution, used only by the 3D scene exchange's fixed scripts. Agent modeling goes through the built-in blender_execute (approval card, own autopilot gate).

help.zh: 3D 场景互通要求 Blender 与 Mosael 后端运行在同一台电脑。Blender 的 MCP Add-on 只听 IPv4,所以没有 ::1。
help.en: Scene exchange requires Blender and the Mosael backend on the same computer. The Blender MCP add-on listens on IPv4 only, so ::1 is not offered.
